title: Kianuni/Erosion-CN
why_read: Another MobileGestalt research toolbox for iOS configuration, overlapping heavily with similar tools and offering little distinct technical insight for a general audience.
analysis: This is a Chinese-language toolbox for researching and modifying iOS system configuration values, branded as a 'safety hardening' tool against being flagged or restricted (White Apple refers to bricked/restricted devices). It's part of the same jailbreak-adjacent ecosystem as other MobileGestalt editors, mostly useful to a narrow community of iOS tinkerers. There's no indication of novel technical contribution beyond existing similar tools. It's a low-interest item for a general engineering digest.
